name: Vision eval v1
description: Runs all 60 items of eval-vision-v1 at temperature 0 and reports accuracy overall, by category and by difficulty. Pinned together with the dataset: a change to either means a new -v2 id.

eval.notes: Attach the row's `image` as a base64 data URL image_url content part next to the prompt text, then score with the row's own scorer. A text-only model scores near zero; record that result rather than skipping the workload.

notes: accuracy and avg_latency_ms live in the result's `scores` block, not in `metrics`; success_rate is the share of requests that completed at all and is independent of whether the answers were right.
